claims.claim: Rockwell's June 30, 2026 10-Q shows inventories of $1.243B, essentially flat with $1.247B at Sept. 30, 2025, while receivables were $1.937B versus $1.931B; this accompanies the company's separately reported Q3 organic sales acceleration rather than an inventory build.

factors.name: working-capital inventory discipline
factors.basis: Inventory remained essentially flat across nine months despite stronger reported sales, reducing evidence of inventory-led growth.

risks.risk: Flat aggregate inventory does not prove channel inventory health or end-customer sell-through; root-owner underwriting should avoid that inference.

causalEdges.from: sales growth without aggregate inventory expansion
causalEdges.mechanism: revenue growth is less likely to be explained by company-held inventory accumulation
causalEdges.falsifier: channel inventories or future receivable quality deteriorate materially

unknowns.unknown: Channel inventory and customer order quality are not quantified in this filing excerpt.

claims.claim: Rockwell completed the Sensia joint-venture dissolution on April 1, 2026, received a $40M cash payment, derecognized net assets including $89M of short-term debt, and recognized a $20M pre-tax gain; June 30 commercial paper borrowings were $684M at a 3.89% weighted average rate.

factors.name: portfolio simplification and financing context
factors.basis: Sensia dissolution removed associated debt and simplified the portfolio, but short-term commercial paper remained meaningful relative to $479M cash.

risks.risk: Some reported profitability improvement includes a one-time $20M Sensia dissolution gain and portfolio effects; these should not be treated as recurring operating performance.

causalEdges.mechanism: asset/liability derecognition plus a transaction gain changes comparability with prior periods
causalEdges.falsifier: none; this is a disclosed transaction effect requiring normalization rather than a forecast

unknowns.unknown: Scout does not determine normalized EPS, leverage ratios or canonical score impact; those remain Alpha-owned.
